description:
Look up any x402 seller by hostname: its rank among all sellers, 30-day calls, estimated revenue and paying wallets, each endpoint's numbers and price, its categories and competitors, and labels where its numbers look unusual. Weekly, from Coinbase's Bazaar catalog.

$0.02 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: x402_seller_lookup
